translation: The Ba Mai Jing (Eight Vessels Classic) of Zhang Ziyang says: The eight vessels are: the Chong meridian below the Fengfu point, the Du meridian behind the navel, the Ren meridian in front of the navel, the Dai meridian at the waist, the Yin Qiao meridian in front of the coccyx (weilü) below the scrotum, the Yang Qiao meridian two segments behind the coccyx, the Yin Wei meridian one cun and three fen in front of the crown, and the Yang Wei meridian one cun and three fen behind the crown. Every person has these eight vessels; they all belong to the yin spirit and are sealed and not opened, and only the immortals burst them open with yang-qi, and so can attain the Dao. The eight vessels are the root of the great way of former heaven (xiantian) and the ancestor of the one qi.
